title: emergency9-guard
desc: T1 core reflex for the emergency9 guard (tools/wkharness-guards-emergency9.ps1, E1-E9 destructive-command classes). Spec and exemption scope: emergency9-guard-howto.
steps: TRIGGER: E3-harness-self-destruct blocks a delete/move/rename of a harness-critical path (tools/wkharness*.ps1, tools/Agent.*, a family config, .githooks/*, CLAUDE.md, HANDOFF.md). ACTION: do not fight it and do not rename around it -- edit the file instead (editing is always allowed, only destroying is blocked), or read emergency9-guard-howto for the quarantine tool.;TRIGGER: you need to delete a spent -proto or -probe sandbox file, of ANY extension, or anything under .tmp/. ACTION: just delete it -- both classes are exempt from E3 as of 2026-09-15, checked before the protected-path match. If the delete still gets blocked, the target is not actually under .tmp/ and does not actually end in -proto/-probe before its extension; re-check the exact filename rather than assuming the exemption is broken.;TRIGGER: you are about to change E3's exemption scope, or wire something into this guard. ACTION: read emergency9-guard-howto FIRST for the full spec (why the core protected list never gets a rename escape, the module location, the self-test contract) -- this core is reflexes only, not the spec. //why:letter and global md edited by file edit with backups only-sonnet //why:stale index lock bypassed by a separate index, not deleted-sonnet //why:check target before blaming the exemption-sonnet

requirements.expect: shows the two TRIGGER/ACTION reflexes plus the howto pointer
shows GUARD IDENTITY, SPEC, EXEMPTION SCOPE
